layers.message: Deploy to ECS from GitHub Actions
Record project context for beneficiary bulk import

graderOnly: Valid Auditor context (.standards/CONTEXT.md) records an established Django REST Framework service on MySQL 8.0 (Amazon RDS) deployed to AWS ECS Fargate. The bulk-import endpoint is a bounded FEATURE design.

Redis (the existing Celery broker), pytest with pytest-django, and GitHub Actions are already established project tooling. Using or naming them is not a default-stack proposal. Assertion 1 fails only when the design proposes FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Railway, GCP, or another default-stack replacement for Django REST Framework, MySQL, or ECS, or a migration toward them. Naming them as rejected alternatives is allowed.
The scope and project context are complete and consistent. No scoping or project-context defect is intended.

all.why: the persisted design, created by artifact init at its fixed path, builds on Django
the design names the established MySQL database
Architect changes no dependencies, settings, or deployment files; a stack migration would show up here

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Architect writes no production code, tests, or user documentation

selfChecks.why: the project's Python sources are syntactically valid
the ECS task definition cited by the context is valid JSON
CONTEXT.md states that Django was not available in the audit environment, so the suite was not run
CONTEXT.md states that no MySQL server was available in the audit environment

notes: Standalone fixture. Pre-install layers: 50-project commits an established Django 4.2 / DRF 3.15 service on MySQL (mysqlclient), with Celery and a Redis broker for the registration SMS, a load_villages CSV management command, and pytest-django tests. 51-deploy adds the Dockerfile, an ECS Fargate task definition (web and worker containers, RDS host, ElastiCache broker, Secrets Manager), a GitHub Actions CI/deploy workflow to ECR and ECS, and the full README. 60-audit commits .standards/CONTEXT.md, the Auditor context that records the stack, conventions, nearest analogues, and audit limitations, together with MODE.md and a STATE.md in SCOPING after the Auditor's FORWARD handoff. 61-scope commits the Scoper record with AC-001 to AC-008 and a STATE.md in ARCHITECTING: STANDARD, FULL_DELIVERABLE, Architecture NONE, recovery inactive. The project tests cannot run in the runner because Django and MySQL are not installed. The context says so, and the selfChecks prove it.
